cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: the open side door of a camper van parked by a lake at night — perched on a ledge or edge; a medieval guild workshop — holds her keepsake at chest height; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — loops the strap of a camera over her head; the top of a restored ancient city wall — standing; a western coastal signal tower with an open gallery and a large brass viewing telescope on a fixed stand — she is a signal-keeper taking a break after looking through the telescope; her crew cabin aboard a starship — holds a book closed against her chest; a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — kneeling on the ground; an esports arena — rests a pair of inflatable cheering sticks against her shoulder; a neon-lit bar counter with backlit bottles — eats from a bowl of hot food set on the table in front of her; a starship observation deck with a vast curved window onto a nebula — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — lying on her front; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a traditional archery ground beside a temple wall — sweeps the floor beside her with a small hand brush
